msgs.author: ifeolayeni
msgs.content:
Gap Call is live on Robinhood Chain testnet.

Stocks close. Stock Tokens don’t.

That gap is what I built around.

On Gap Call, you make a percentage call on where NVDA, TSLA or SPY lands across the Friday → Sunday gap, then back your prediction with $GAP.

Your call stays editable through the week — Friday only sets the starting price. Calls lock Sunday at 7 PM ET, before the reference market returns, then the actual move settles the round and we see who got closest.

$GAP isn’t just the token beside the app either. It’s the conviction behind each call, verified against your wallet balance when you submit.

Try it: https://gapcall.vercel.app

$GAP / NVDA: https://testnet.vibevibe.fun/token/0x303b519D4769347dBc90266c723EBAe74C34dC02

Would love some actual calls on the board — especially if you think NVDA is opening up or down.  https://x.com/lordhegambit/status/2101698601046937684?s=20

channel_global-chat.author: covenant11
channel_global-chat.content:
The purpose of the testnet funds is to give builders a way to experiment with launching tokens that have actual utility behind them.

For example, if you’re building a game, you can use the testnet funds to launch a token connected to that game. The token could then be used for in-game items, access, rewards, upgrades, or other mechanics you come up with.

It doesn’t have to be a game either. You could build any product, application, or innovation around your token and experiment with different ways to give it utility and reward the people using or holding it.

The whole point is to let builders test these ideas on-chain before taking them further.
